messages:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — we need to lock the priorities for the visibility work this sprint: dashboards, tracing hooks, cost breakdown by route/model, and error analytics. Who owns final launch criteria?
Jon Doe: I can own launch criteria for dashboards. Need a compact list of KPIs and a canary plan.
Sarah Patel: For tracing hooks, we need 3 asks: low-overhead sampling, redaction rules for PII, and an integration point for the error pipeline.
Kevin Liu: Cost breakdown: customers keep asking for per-tenant + per-model token cost. That's nontrivial — requires tagging at request ingress and aggregation in billing.
Alex Kim: Re: tagging — we should push tags into the request meta at the API gateway. Minimal change to runtime.
Maria Chen: @Kevin what effort to expose per-route breakdown in Console? rough T-shirt?
Kevin Liu: Engineer-level estimate: small frontend + backend join work = ~3 wks (1 eng + 0.5 FE). But backend needs event redesign for route_id and model_variant tags.
Jon Doe: For dashboards, acceptance criteria proposal: 1) Pre-baked dashboard templates for latency, token spend, error rate by route/model; 2) Drilldown from dashboard to traces/errors; 3) RBAC so enterprise customers can only see their data.
Sarah Patel: Tracing hooks acceptance: 1) must instrument request start/end w/ route_id and model_id, 2) support probabilistic sampling config per-customer, 3) export to traces backend w/ redaction applied.
Maria Chen: Can we standardize the telemetry schema now? we need a small contract (fields + types) so eng infra can implement.
Alex Kim: I'll draft schema today. Minimal fields: request_id, timestamp, customer_id (hashed), route_id, model_id, tokens_in, tokens_out, latency_ms, error_flag, error_code.
Kevin Liu: Important: token counts must be computed at the model-serving boundary, not the API shim. Otherwise we misattribute batching.
Jon Doe: UX note — dashboards should support "cost allocation" toggles: by route / by model / by team. Also export CSV.
Sarah Patel: Security: enterprise asks that trace payloads for errors be scrubbed. We need a redaction checklist (emails, keys, prompts).
Maria Chen: Launch gating: must pass non-regression on latency (95p + p50 within 5%), RBAC verification, and two enterprise customers validated feature in beta.
eng-bot: reminder: perf-test-canary triggered on 1716130000 — will run perf suite against visibility API.
Kevin Liu: If canary fails, fallback plan is to enable reduced sampling + disable heavy aggregations.
Alex Kim: Drafting rollout plan: alpha internal -> beta with 2 customers -> gradual ramp (25% increments) -> GA. Will add rollout dates to the roadmap doc.
Jon Doe: What about storage/retention for traces/cost aggregates? propose 90d detailed traces + 365d aggregated metrics.
Sarah Patel: Agree. Also add alerting: error-rate spike > 2x baseline for 5m triggers oncall.
Maria Chen: Action items: Alex draft schema + rollout dates (due EOD), Kevin scope backend event changes (due Wed), Jon create dashboard templates (due Fri), Sarah produce redaction checklist (due Thu).
Kevin Liu: FYI: enterprise compliance ask: ability to disable trace export entirely per-customer. We'll include that toggle.
Alex Kim: Noted. I'll include `trace_export_enabled` flag in schema.
Jon Doe: I'll start a canary checklist doc and link to it here when ready.
Maria Chen: Thanks — we'll review status in Thurs PM sync. :thumbsup:
